items.titolo: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
items.descrizione: An experiment in which AI models were asked to break into simulated networks showed the hacking skills of DeepSeek and GLM to be not far behind OpenAI’s most advanced cyber model, which isn’t public.

items.titolo: Rogue AI tasked with renumbering pages accidentally deletes law professor's entire syllabus, one year of lecture notes
items.descrizione: A University of Chicago lecturer has revealed a rogue Claude AI agent deleted his entire syllabus and year's worth of lecture notes by mistake.
